svg.title: Green Blue Red
svg.desc: Interpretive study after a visually inspected primary museum photograph. Approximate geometry; interpretive screen colours. Observed red ground with green rectangle at left and tall blue oval at right. Oval contour and margins are approximated from the object photograph. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of red, green, blue; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://www.thebroad.org/art/ellsworth-kelly/green-blue-red; object B-KELLY-2013.001; reviewed 2026-10-27; not a facsimile.
